title: Turkish Citizenship by Investment: Open Data
description:
Machine-readable reference data on Türkiye's citizenship-by-investment programme. Qualifying investment thresholds and the statutory basis for each, the conditions attached to every route, government and third-party transaction costs, the documents an application requires by nationality and family position, published statistics on citizenship acquisitions and foreign property purchases, and an index of the primary sources behind each figure.

Every figure is dated and attributed to the instrument or publication it comes from, with its Resmî Gazete date where one exists. The dataset also records, explicitly, what Türkiye does not publish and which figures in circulation do not reconcile against primary sources, so that gaps are visible rather than silently interpolated.

Maintained by Ra Legal, a law firm in Istanbul, and by Av. Rüzgar Sevimli, registered with the Istanbul Bar Association under number 69519. The registration number is published so that anyone relying on the data can check who stands behind it against the Bar's own roll.

General information about Turkish law. Not legal advice.
